expr: (((List.range prices.length).flatMap (fun i => (List.range prices.length).map (fun j => if i < j then prices[j]! - prices[i]! else 0))).foldl max 0)

lemmas.name: profit42
lemmas.statement: ∀ (prices : List Nat) (h : maxProfit_precond prices), maxProfit_postcond prices (((List.range prices.length).flatMap (fun i => (List.range prices.length).map (fun j => if i < j then prices[j]! - prices[i]! else 0))).foldl max 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by
  intro prices h
  generalize hD : (List.range prices.length).flatMap (fun i => (List.range prices.length).map
      (fun j => if i < j then prices[j]! - prices[i]! else 0)) = D
  have hmemD : ∀ d, d ∈ D ↔ ∃ i, i < prices.length ∧ ∃ j, j < prices.length ∧ (if i < j then prices[j]! - prices[i]! else 0) = d := by
    intro d; rw [← hD]; simp [List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := Refine.foldl_max_facts D 0
  generalize D.foldl max 0 = M at h1 h2 h3
  have hle : ∀ i j, i < prices.length → j < prices.length → i < j → prices[j]! - prices[i]! ≤ M := by
    intro i j hi hj hij
    have := h3 _ ((hmemD _).mpr ⟨i, hi, j, hj, rfl⟩)
    rwa [if_pos hij] at this
  have hex : M > 0 → ∃ i j, i < prices.length ∧ j < prices.length ∧ i < j ∧ prices[j]! - prices[i]! = M := by
    intro hM
    have hmem : M ∈ D := by
      rcases h1 with h | h
      · omega
      · exact h
    obtain ⟨i, hi, j, hj, h⟩ := (hmemD M).mp hmem
    by_cases hij : i < j
    · rw [if_pos hij] at h; exact ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hij, h⟩
    · rw [if_neg hij] at h; omega
  have hget : ∀ i, i < prices.length → prices.zipIdx[i]? = some (prices[i]!, i) := by
    intro i hi; rw [List.getElem?_zipIdx]; simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, getElem!_pos prices i hi]
  unfold maxProfit_postcond
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [List.pairwise_iff_getElem]
    intro a b ha hb hab
    simp only [List.length_zipIdx] at ha hb
    simp only [List.getElem_zipIdx]
    intro _
    have := hle a b ha hb hab
    rw [getElem!_pos prices a ha, getElem!_pos prices b hb] at this
    exact this
  · constructor
    · intro hM0
      right
      rw [List.all_eq_true]
      rintro ⟨pi, i⟩ hx
      rw [List.all_eq_true]
      rintro ⟨pj, j⟩ hy
      have hx' := List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mp hx
      have hy' := List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mp hy
      simp only at hx' hy'
      have hi : i < prices.length := by
        by_contra hge; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)] at hx'; simp at hx'
      have hj : j < prices.length := by
        by_contra hge; rw [List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega)] at hy'; simp at hy'
      simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
      by_cases hij : i < j
      · right
        have := hle i j hi hj hij
        rw [getElem!_pos prices i hi, getElem!_pos prices j hj] at this
        rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi] at hx'; rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj] at hy'
        simp at hx' hy'
        subst hx'; subst hy'
        omega
      · left; omega
    · intro hcond
      by_contra hM
      obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hij, hd⟩ := hex (by omega)
      rcases hcond with hlen | hall
      · omega
      · have := List.all_eq_true.mp hall (prices[i]!, i) (List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mpr (by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, getElem!_pos prices i hi]))
        have := List.all_eq_true.mp this (prices[j]!, j) (List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mpr (by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, getElem!_pos prices j hj]))
        simp only [decide_eq_true_eq] at this
        omega
  · intro hM
    obtain ⟨i, j, hi, hj, hij, hd⟩ := hex hM
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨(prices[i]!, i), List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mpr (by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi, getElem!_pos prices i hi]), ?_⟩
    rw [List.any_eq_true]
    refine ⟨(prices[j]!, j), List.mem_zipIdx_iff_getElem?.mpr (by simp [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hj, getElem!_pos prices j hj]), ?_⟩
    simp only [decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact ⟨hij, hd⟩
